record.paper_title: Open problems on graph eigenvalues studied with AutoGraphiX
record.original_question: Let r and n be positive integers with n >= 6r + 4, and let p = floor(r/2) and q = ceil(r/2). If P_n^{p×6;q×6} denotes the graph obtained from r copies of C_6 and a path P_(n-6r) with endpoints u and v by joining u to one vertex in each of p of the 6-cycles and v to one vertex in each of the remaining q 6-cycles, one edge per attachment, does every connected r-cyclic graph G on n vertices satisfy E(G) <= E(P_n^{p×6;q×6})? Must equality occur only when G is isomorphic to P_n^{p×6;q×6}?

evidence.quote: Conjecture 5.13 Let r and n be positive integers such that n >= 6r + 4. Then E(G) <= E(P^p×6;q×6_n), where p = floor(r/2) and q = ceil(r/2), with equality if and only if G ≡ P^p×6;q×6_n.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a simple graph. The energy of $G$ is $E(G)=\sum_{i=1}^{n}|\lambda_i|$, where $\lambda_1,\dots,\lambda_n$ are the eigenvalues of the adjacency matrix of $G$. A connected graph on $n$ vertices with $m$ edges is called $r$-cyclic if $m=n+r-1$ (equivalently, its cyclomatic number is $r$).

For positive integers $r$ and $n$ with $n\ge 6r+4$, set $p=\lfloor r/2\rfloor$ and $q=\lceil r/2\rceil$. Let $C_6^{(1)},\dots,C_6^{(r)}$ be $r$ vertex-disjoint copies of the 6-cycle, and let $P_{n-6r}$ be a path on $n-6r$ vertices with endpoints $u$ and $v$. Define the graph $P_n^{p\times 6;\, q\times 6}$ to be obtained from the disjoint union of $P_{n-6r}$ and the $r$ copies of $C_6$ by adding $r$ edges: from $u$ to exactly one vertex of each of $p$ of the 6-cycles, and from $v$ to exactly one vertex of each of the remaining $q$ 6-cycles (one edge per attached cycle). Note that $P_n^{p\times 6;\, q\times 6}$ is a connected $r$-cyclic graph on $n$ vertices.

Prove or disprove: for every connected $r$-cyclic graph $G$ on $n$ vertices,
$$E(G)\le E\bigl(P_n^{p\times 6;\, q\times 6}\bigr),$$
with equality if and only if $G\cong P_n^{p\times 6;\, q\times 6}$.
artifact.status_search_result: The conjecture appears to remain open in general. It was formulated via AutoGraphiX experiments as a general $r$-cyclic extension of the maximum-energy conjectures for unicyclic, bicyclic, tricyclic and tetracyclic graphs. While the unicyclic case has been completely settled and partial progress exists for tricyclic and tetracyclic cases, no proof of the general $r$-cyclic statement for $n\ge 6r+4$ has been found in the literature.

status_evidence.title: Open problems on graph eigenvalues studied with AutoGraphiX
status_evidence.snippet: Conjectures on maximum energy of r-cyclic graphs for n >= 6r+4 are listed as open problems.
status_evidence.claim: The general r-cyclic maximum energy conjecture is stated as an open problem.

status_evidence.title: Complete solution to a conjecture on the maximal energy of unicyclic graphs
status_evidence.snippet: Solves the unicyclic (r=1) case of maximum-energy conjectures.
status_evidence.claim: Only the unicyclic case has been completely solved; higher r remains.

status_evidence.title: On a Conjecture about Tricyclic Graphs with Maximal Energy
status_evidence.snippet: Addresses the tricyclic case (r=3) of the maximum-energy conjecture.
status_evidence.claim: Partial progress exists for small r but the general r-cyclic conjecture remains open.
